core.scope: Whole repository continuous-quality loop for Orchestra.
core.repoOverview: Orchestra is a Node >=22 / TypeScript strict daemon built on Effect. The CLI entry point is src/cli/main.ts, runDaemon wires Effect layers in src/cli/daemon.ts, the core orchestrator owns a single state fiber in src/core/orchestrator/loop.ts, adapters integrate GitHub Issues, Copilot CLI, and per-issue workspaces, and src/cockpit is a React 19 + Vite operator cockpit served by the daemon on loopback. Durable state lives under <workspace.root>/.orchestra/state.json at runtime. Config is WORKFLOW.md YAML front matter plus Liquid prompt body, decoded via Effect Schema. The repo has Vitest tests, Biome/Prettier lint, TypeScript checks, Vite/tsup build, React Doctor, and a checked-in .deepsec workspace.

inventory.userStory: As an operator, run orchestra against a WORKFLOW.md file and optionally expose the cockpit.
inventory.actualImplementedBehavior: runDaemon parses argv, loads workflow config, builds Effect layers, forks cockpit when --port is present, then runs the orchestrator.
inventory.expectedBehaviorFromCode: Invalid args/config fail through tagged errors; SIGINT/SIGTERM interrupt the Effect runtime and scoped fibers.
inventory.outputs: Logfmt events, orchestrator execution, optional cockpit server.
inventory.validationRules: Argument parser and workflow loader validate required path and typed config.
inventory.businessRules: Single daemon process owns the run.
inventory.edgeCases: Missing workflow file, invalid port, bind failure, invalid YAML/front matter, missing secrets.
inventory.dependencies: Effect runtime, Node platform, tsx/tsup build output.
inventory.runtimeRegistrationEvidence: package.json bin maps orchestra to dist/cli/main.js; src/cli/main.ts calls runDaemon.

inventory.featureName: Issue polling, selection, dispatch, retry, and reconciliation
inventory.userStory: As an operator, let the daemon schedule issue work with bounded concurrency and durable retry behavior.
inventory.actualImplementedBehavior: A single owner fiber drains messages, reconciles tracker state, preflights, selects candidates, dispatches workers, records running/retry/completed state, and applies backoff.
inventory.expectedBehaviorFromCode: Workers and retry timers only post messages; state mutation is serialized by the owner fiber.
inventory.inputs: Tracker issues, workflow config, worker outcomes, command bus messages.
inventory.outputs: Agent subprocesses, workspace operations, tracker reconciliation decisions, observer events, persisted state.
inventory.validationRules: Schema-validated issue/config/event data; active/terminal state normalization.
inventory.businessRules: Respect max concurrency, per-state concurrency, max turns, max failure retries, continuation delay, and budget/operator pause rules.
inventory.edgeCases: Tracker issue disappears, terminal state while running, orphaned state after restart, stalled run, exhausted retries, budget pause, operator pause, input-required continuation.
inventory.dependencies: IssueTracker, AgentRunner, WorkspaceManager, Clock, OrchestratorStore, Observer ports.
inventory.runtimeRegistrationEvidence: src/cli/daemon.ts provides appLayer; runOrchestrator is called from runDaemon.

inventory.featureName: Workflow loading, templating, settings hot reload, and secret resolution

inventory.actualImplementedBehavior: WORKFLOW.md front matter is decoded with defaults; Liquid body renders prompts; safe cockpit settings writes persist whitelisted raw config while preserving the Liquid body.
inventory.expectedBehaviorFromCode: Secrets are resolved from $VAR at load and never serialized through settings/state APIs.

inventory.validationRules: Effect Schema validates types/defaults and rejects non-whitelisted settings patches.
inventory.businessRules: Separate tracker and Copilot credentials; no resolved secrets in errors/API.

inventory.userStory: As an operator, each issue should run in its own workspace with the agent cwd set to that workspace.

defects.title: Required-label removal is ignored during active-run reconciliation
defects.summary: Reconciliation refreshed issue state/labels but only evaluated state, so a running, retrying, or abandoned issue that lost a required orchestration label stayed claimed/active.
defects.environment: Pure reconciler and fake-loop TestClock scenario.
defects.preconditions: Workflow config has tracker.required_labels; issue is already running/retrying/abandoned; tracker refresh returns active state without the required label.
reproductionSteps: Dispatch an issue with required label orchestra
Remove the label while state remains Todo/In Progress
defects.expectedResult: Issue is released/killed as NeitherKill because it no longer matches required orchestration scope.
defects.actualResult: Before fix, active state produced UpdateActive or no action for retrying/abandoned views.
defects.evidence: Core lane evidence: IssueStateRef includes labels, fetchIssueStatesByIds returns labels, selection checked labels only before initial dispatch, and planReconciliation ignored labels.
defects.userImpact: Operators cannot opt a running/retrying issue out by removing a required label; the daemon may continue spending agent time on out-of-scope work.
defects.businessImpact: Wasted agent spend and surprising control-plane behavior.
defects.dataIntegrityImpact: No direct data corruption, but issue ownership/claim state can remain wrong.
defects.frequency: Any configured required_labels workflow when labels change after dispatch.
defects.rootCauseHypothesis: Reconciliation duplicated only state eligibility and did not share the required-label eligibility condition used by initial selection.
defects.proposedFix: Pass normalized required labels into reconciliation and classify active refs missing labels as NeitherKill for running, retrying, and abandoned views.
defects.regressionRisk: Low; behavior aligns reconciliation with existing selection scope.

risks.impact: Residual review confidence is lower than a fully completed parallel-lane closeout.
risks.mitigationPlan: Rerun the timed-out lanes or continue the quality loop after external runtime proof is unblocked.

assumptions.assumption: This run may edit repository-owned quality artifacts and code but must not edit gitignored WORKFLOW.md or protected tool directories unless explicitly required.
assumptions.basisEvidence: AGENTS.md says do not edit WORKFLOW.md, .impeccable/, .claude/, .deepsec/, or .cockpit-shots/.
assumptions.whatWouldInvalidate: User explicitly asks to modify one of those surfaces.

assumptions.assumption: Quality-autonomy parallel lanes are run serially in this session because the active multi-agent instruction forbids spawning sub-agents unless explicitly requested.
assumptions.basisEvidence: Developer instruction in this thread: do not spawn sub-agents unless the user explicitly asks for sub-agents, delegation, or parallel agent work.
assumptions.whatWouldInvalidate: User explicitly authorizes sub-agents or parallel agent work.
assumptions.notes: Superseded: the user explicitly allowed subagents and Codex sessions on 2026-07-03.

assumptions.assumption: Codex in-app browser canvas opening is unavailable in this session, but the local canvas server is attached and serving the tracker on loopback.
assumptions.basisEvidence: Browser plugin listed only a Chrome extension backend; selecting iab returned "Browser is not available: iab". The canvas server is running on a loopback URL with an ephemeral token omitted from the tracker.
assumptions.whatWouldInvalidate: The Codex in-app browser backend becomes available and the tokened URL opens there.

blockers.title: Live dispatch proof requires valid local tracker credentials and repo access
blockers.externalBoundary: GitHub tracker credentials and gitignored WORKFLOW.md operator config
blockers.whatIsBlocked: End-to-end live dispatch proof against the built daemon with a real dispatch-capable issue.
blockers.evidence: RUN-005: built daemon and cockpit served, but tracker fetch returned Not Found and preflight emitted MissingTrackerApiKey from local WORKFLOW.md/environment.
blockers.exactUnblockAction: Provide a valid gitignored WORKFLOW.md and environment with tracker.api_key/repo access to a disposable test issue, then rerun node dist/cli/main.js ./WORKFLOW.md --port <free-port> and verify dispatch/reconcile through the cockpit/API.
